critique: The black background and warm amber/orange palette are appropriate, and the field of soft circular elements is closer to decorative lights than the first pass. However, the circles still read as dark, shaded sprite spheres with visible brown rims instead of bright self-illuminated bulbs/bokeh. The frame-to-frame population also remains uneven: t4 is noticeably busier and more clustered than t1, rather than holding a consistent field while individual lights flicker.

suggestions.why: Maximize particle feathering to suppress the hard dark sprite edges and make each element read more like a soft light source.
Reduce the oversized bulb shapes so the composition has more delicate bokeh-like lights rather than dominant shaded balls.
Lower ongoing particle emission to reduce the visible population increase and crowding by t4.
Increase the built-in glow opacity so the softened particles feel luminous rather than muddy and volumetric.
